blocks.html: Learn Calligraphy, the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with the use of a pen or brush, in a 2-day Basic Caligraphy Workshop for children aged 9 and above, at Robinsons Magnolia on August 20 and 21 (Saturday and Sunday) at 2pm. For the workshop scheduled on the 20th of August, participants will receive pointed nibs and ink while participants who will be joining on the 21st of August, participants will be receive a Watercolor set, watercolor paper and brush. Participants or their guardians are requested to submit proof of purchase starting August 13 to 21. Receipts must be dated within the promo period to be valid.
